articles.summary: Minecraft Players on Nintendo Switch(tm) 2 and XBOX Set to Get a New Rematch Wireless Controller That Features Vibrant RGB Lighting to Bring an Iconic Minecraft Design to Life SAN DIEGO Sept. 26, 2026 Leading gaming accessories maker Turtle Beach Corporation (Nasdaq: TBCH), today announced its new family of Minecraft(tm) Dungeons II themed peripherals including an exclusive controller, headset and travel case that celebrate the highly anticipated Dungeons II game are now available globally. Officially licensed by Mojang and Nintendo (r) , the new Turtle Beach(r) Rematch(tm) Wireless Gaming Controller Minecraft Dungeons II for Nintendo Switch(tm) 2 features a dynamic lenticular design that shifts from Valorie to Creeper while Turtle Beachs renowned engineering lets players triumphantly wield their sword as they thwart danger in unexplored worlds. The premium TMR thumbsticks ensure drift-free precision attacks on the mob hordes
